title: Planning stores follow actual account and authority changes
description: On an isolated gateway, use a disposable account and actual sign-in/sign-out. Warm five lists, downgrade admin to operator with farm access retained, then revoke all access. Verify saved forbidden rows disappear and allowed lists require new reads, recover through real source changes, then retire only the test identity.

proofTargets.claim: Switching accounts through the real UI deletes all five old saved planning collections.
An operator downgrade retains farm access, freshly reads three allowed lists and clears saved roadmap/project facts.
Revoking the disposable account's admin role clears all five saved and cached planning collections.
Restored authority refetches all five lists through their actual mounted views.
The original browser account is restored; test credentials and principal are retired without changing its roles.

prove.intent: Prove real account switching, role revocation and recovery across five saved planning collections.

switch.intent: Normal account switching deletes the previous principal's saved planning rows.

partial-role.intent: Retain farm access while clearing forbidden planning facts and refetching permitted collections.

revoke.intent: A real admin-role revocation clears every saved planning collection.

recover.intent: Restored authority requires new current reads on all five actual views.

cleanup.intent: Restore the original account and remove only the disposable principal and credential.
